lore.stats.luck: Reduces damage taken by 10%% per level.
lore.stats.unluck: Increases damage taken by 10%% per level.
lore.stats.poison: Lose (2.5%%*Level) of max health per second, ignoring any defence.
lore.stats.mc_poison: Whenever poison takes effect or you take damage, receive (1*Level) environmental damage.
lore.stats.strength: Increases all damage dealt by 30%% per level.
lore.stats.weakness: Reduces all damage dealt by 20%% per level.
lore.stats.speed: Increases your movement speed by 20%% per level.
lore.stats.hasten: Increases your attack speed by 10%% and mining speed by 20%% per level.
lore.estats.vulnerable: Increases all types of damage taken by the enemy, including fixed percentage damage.
lore.estats.poison: The enemy loses (2.5%%*Level) of max health per second, ignoring any defence, except for bosses.
lore.estats.mc_poison: Whenever poison takes effect on the enemy or they are attacked, they take an additional (1*Level) magic damage. No enemy is immune to poison.
lore.estats.weakness: Reduces the enemy's melee and projectile damage by (15*Level)%%, and magic damage by (10*Level)%%, up to level V.
lore.estats.bleed: The enemy takes (1*Level) damage per second, ignoring any defence.
lore.estats.frozen: The enemy is frozen, unable to move, attack, or use active skills.
lore.estats.stunned: The enemy is stunned, unable to move, but can use active skills.
lore.estats.blinded: The enemy is blinded, unable to track and lock onto targets.
name.defence.lore: The defence calculations below only include base defence and protection-type enchantments. Defence against hazard damage is reduced by 50%%. You can manually set the multiplier below to account for special enchantments.
name.defence.enhance.lore: Some enchantments increase your defence under special conditions. You can select the multiplier here.
name.defence.enhance.name: <Multiplier: x%s.%s>
name.special.lore: Special items you have encountered will be recorded here.
name.option.music.hint:
Music and loot filter settings apply to individual players.
Difficulty settings apply to all players.
Hover over options for details.
lore.option.difficulty:
On Easy, enemy health is reduced by 10%%,
attack damage by 25%%, and hazard damage by 15%%.

No changes on Normal.

On Hard, enemy health is increased by 10%%,
attack damage by 25%%, and hazard damage by 15%%.
lore.option.pickup:
When enabled, irrelevant drops will not be picked up,
except items actively thrown by the player.
name.enchantment.thorns.lore: When damaged, deal (1*Level) damage to the attacker, trigger melee enchantment effects, without extra durability loss.
name.enchantment.unbreaking.lore: The chance for your armor and weapons to consume durability is reduced to (1/enchantment level).
name.enchantment.agility.lore: Increases jump strength by 0.14 and safe fall distance by 1.2 blocks per level.
name.enchantment.chain_break.lore: Breaking a spawner destroys nearby spawners. Range increases with level.
name.enchantment.energy.lore: After killing an enemy, increases movement speed by 15%% per level for 8 seconds.
name.enchantment.eruption.lore: Breaking a spawner deals 5 damage to all nearby enemies and triggers melee enchantments.
name.enchantment.frenzy.lore: After killing an enemy, increases attack damage by 25%% per level for 8 seconds.
name.enchantment.hasten.lore: After killing an enemy, increases attack speed by 15%% per level for 8 seconds.
name.enchantment.life_drain.lore: After killing an enemy, restores 1 health per level.
name.enchantment.regeneration.lore: Regenerate 1 health every 5 seconds. Each additional level reduces the interval by 0.5 seconds, up to 1 health per second.
name.enchantment.sapper.lore: When breaking a spawner, restores 1 health per level.
name.enchantment.protection.lore: Provides (4*Level)%% defence against all damage types within the Protection tier, up to 90%%.
name.enchantment.melee_protection.lore: Provides (6*Level)%% defence against melee damage within the Protection tier, up to 90%%.
name.enchantment.projectile_protection.l: Provides (6*Level)%% defence against ranged damage within the Protection tier, up to 90%%.
name.enchantment.magic_protection.lore: Provides (6*Level)%% defence against magic damage within the Protection tier, up to 90%%.
Provides (6*Level)%% defence against environmental damage within the Protection tier, up to 90%%.
name.enchantment.evasion.lore: Provides (4*Level)%% chance to evade all damage types within the Evasion tier, up to 80%%.
name.enchantment.melee_evasion.lore: Provides (8*Level)%% chance to evade melee damage within the Evasion tier, up to 80%%.
name.enchantment.magic_evasion.lore: Provides (8*Level)%% chance to evade magic damage within the Evasion tier, up to 80%%.
name.enchantment.range_evasion.lore: Provides (8*Level)%% chance to evade ranged damage within the Evasion tier, up to 80%%.
name.enchantment.absorption.lore: For each point of absorption, increases defence by 5%% per enchantment level.
name.enchantment.courage.lore: When health is above 60%%, increases defence by an additional 20%% per level.
name.enchantment.death_escape.lore: Allows you to survive a fatal attack. Cooldown: 120 seconds. Each additional level reduces cooldown by 5 seconds.
name.enchantment.invade.lore: After killing an enemy, increases defence by an additional 20%% per level for the next 5 seconds.
name.enchantment.promise.lore: When there are no enemies in front within a certain range, increases defence by an additional 20%% per level.
name.enchantment.ethereal.lore: After taking damage, gain an additional 20%% defence per level for the next 2 seconds.
name.enchantment.tempo.lore: When not taking damage for 4 consecutive seconds, gain an additional 20%% defence per level.
name.enchantment.revolve.lore: When health is below 60%%, increases defence by an additional 20%% per level.
name.enchantment.smite.lore: Deals (2.5*Level) extra damage to undead mobs.
name.enchantment.bane_of_arthropods.lore: Deals (2.5*Level) extra damage to arthropod mobs.
name.enchantment.fire_aspect.lore: Ignites enemies for (4*Level) seconds, up to 20 seconds.
name.enchantment.bleed.lore: Deals an additional (2*Level) melee damage to enemies below 50%% health, including when health drops below 50%% from your attack.
name.enchantment.combo.lore: Attacking twice within 1.5 seconds deals an additional (2*Level) melee damage.
name.enchantment.crit.lore: Critical attacks deal an additional (2*Level) melee damage.
name.enchantment.current.lore: While on the ground, regular attacks deal an additional (2*Level) melee damage.
name.enchantment.curse.lore: Curses an enemy on the first attack. Killing the cursed enemy deals (3*Level) melee damage in a large area.
name.enchantment.first_strike.lore: The first attack on an enemy deals an additional (2*Level) melee damage.
name.enchantment.focus.lore: Deals an additional (2*Level) melee damage when no other enemies are within 3 blocks of the target.
name.enchantment.ice_aspect.lore: Melee attacks slow the enemy. Level equals enchantment level, duration equals (enchantment level + 3) seconds.
name.enchantment.quake.lore: Attacking an enemy deals (2*Level) melee damage to all other nearby enemies.
name.enchantment.slayer.lore: Deals (2.5*Level) extra damage to iron golems, snow golems, and humanoid mobs (such as vindicators and witches).
name.enchantment.thunder_aspect.lore: Has a (10*Level)%% chance to stun the enemy for 1 second, up to 50%%. During this time, they are in <Stunned> state. For elite mobs, replaced by 3 seconds of Slowness V. For bosses, replaced by 3 seconds of Slowness III.
name.enchantment.water_aspect.lore: Melee attacks reduce the enemy's melee and projectile damage by (15*Level)%%, and magic damage by (10*Level)%%, up to level V. Duration: (enchantment level + 3) seconds.
name.enchantment.flame.lore: Ignites enemies for (5*Level) seconds. Applies to bows and crossbows.
name.enchantment.piercing.lore: Your arrows pierce through (1*Level) enemies and can bypass shields.
name.enchantment.multishot.lore: Each shot fires 2 additional arrows, spread to the left and right.
name.enchantment.quick_charge.lore: Reduces your crossbow loading time by 20%% per level.
name.enchantment.punch.lore: Your arrows knock back enemies. Applies to bows and crossbows.
name.enchantment.infinity.lore: Regular arrows you fire do not consume arrows. Applies to bows and crossbows.
name.enchantment.starlit.lore: The enemy you shoot deals (3*Level) projectile damage to all nearby enemies.
name.enchantment.ring.lore: The enemy you shoot creates a ring that pulls all nearby enemies into it.
name.enchantment.greed.lore: The enemy you shoot is pulled towards you.
name.enchantment.freeze.lore: The enemy you shoot is frozen for (0.5*Level) seconds. During this time, they are in <Frozen> state. For elite mobs, replaced by 3 seconds of Slowness V. For bosses, replaced by 3 seconds of Slowness III.
name.enchantment.transformation.lore: Fires your arrow in a specific projectile form, retaining damage while granting new mechanics and effects.
name.enchantment.point_blank.lore: When the enemy hit is within 5 blocks, deals an additional (3*Level) projectile damage. Triggers when both horizontal and vertical distances are within 5 blocks.
name.enchantment.sniper.lore: When the enemy hit is beyond 8 blocks, deals an additional (3*Level) projectile damage. Triggers when the straight-line distance is 8 blocks or more.
name.enchantment.multicharge.lore: When loading a crossbow, you can load an additional (1*Level) arrows and use them consecutively.
name.enchantment.ghost_hunter.lore: Deals (2.5*Level) extra damage to blazes, breezes, endermen, guardians, and creepers.
name.defence.hover_hint: Hover over the text to display specific damage types
name.defence.melee.lore: Primarily from enemy melee attacks and some close-range skills
name.defence.range.lore: Includes arrows, small fireballs, tridents, and other projectiles
name.defence.magic.lore: Includes enemy skills, instant damage, and lightning damage
name.defence.environment.lore: Includes damage from burning, falling, explosions, drowning, thorns, hunger, and poison.
lore.item.intro.upgrade_star: Apply specific enchantments or abilities to equipment or weapons at the Forge.
lore.item.intro.use_in_offhand: Able to be equipped in offhand
lore.item.intro.essence_of_void: Nothing is true, everything is permitted.
lore.item.intro.personal_stats: Right-click to view personal stats and travel journal.
rawtext.enter_game: Welcome to 「%s」 adventure world! Please ensure you and your friends are ready to embark on today's fantasy journey!
rawtext.dungeon.not_loaded: <Area not loaded, please wait or increase render distance>
lore.item.intro.wind_longsword: People wander, gazing afar, wishing the wind is at your back...
lore.item.intro.spring_of_life.1: Sneak + right-click to store potions. Right-click to use the first potion.
lore.item.intro.spring_of_life.2: Non-throwable potions have a 10-second cooldown, throwable potions 3 seconds.
lore.item.intro.spring_of_life.3: After storing, left-click, right-click, or leave to finish.
lore.item.intro.spring_of_life.5: <Please do not place this item in the offhand>
lore.item.intro.spring_of_life.4: Born from forgotten heroes, whose sorrow can make flowers bloom.
lore.item.function.spring_of_life.3: 「Spring of Life」 - first slot does not contain a usable potion!
lore.item.intro.atomic_concrete.1: Sneak + right-click to store items. Right-click to collect
lore.item.intro.atomic_concrete.2: all stored items into a chest item form. 15-second cooldown.
lore.item.intro.atomic_concrete.3: After storing, left-click, right-click, or leave to finish.
lore.item.intro.atomic_concrete.4: A tiny world records all the details of our memories.
lore.item.intro.xenobundle.1: Right-click to open a portable backpack.
lore.item.intro.xenobundle.2: Store or retrieve items from it.
lore.item.intro.xenobundle.4: A tiny palm holds a complete world.
lore.item.intro.anvil.1: Place equipment or weapons in the crafting grid to repair them.
name.enchantment.invert.lore.1: Converts your negative effects into their corresponding positive effects.
name.enchantment.block.lore.1: Periodically grants Absorption I for 30 seconds.
name.enchantment.block.lore.2: Triggers every 60 seconds at level I; each additional level reduces the interval by 5 seconds.
lore.item.intro.ashy_feather.2: like a prelude to rebirth from fire.
lore.item.intro.wolf_dream.1: Looking around, as if their gaze still remains here,
lore.item.intro.wolf_dream.2: though you are certain they have fallen into eternal slumber...
boss.paranoia.mini.1.lore: When enough Magic Scholars gather, they curse you with Vulnerability. The more there are, the higher the level.
boss.paranoia.mini.2.lore: When enough Arcane Scholars gather, they curse you with Weakness. The more there are, the higher the level.
boss.paranoia.s4.lore: Follow Paranoia's weapon color in time to attack it in the corresponding zone.
boss.paranoia.s5.lore: < Stay in the yellow zone to protect yourself >
lore.item.intro.polluted_river.1: A river filled with filth gradually disperses into the sea,
item.hook.name: Hook
item.hook.lore.1: Right-click to fire an anchor point.
item.hook.lore.2: Left-click to pull yourself to the anchor point,
item.hook.lore.3: and grants immunity to fall damage for the next 5 seconds.
item.dantalian.name: Dantalian's Flame
item.dantalian.lore.2: May my echo continue up into the celestial space.
item.dantalian.lore.3: Then, a new sun will eventually rise as well.
name.enchantment.vigor.lore.1: Increases your final melee damage by (2*Level)%%.
name.enchantment.accuracy.lore.1: Increases your final projectile damage by (2*Level)%%.
name.enchantment.soul.lore.1: Increases your final magic damage by (2*Level)%%.
name.enchantment.toughness.lore.1: Increases your final defence amount by (2*Level)%%。
name.enchantment.vitality.lore.1: Increases your final max health by (2*Level)%%。
name.enchantment.swift.lore.1: Increases your final movement speed by (2*Level)%%.
name.enchantment.parry.lore.1: Grants Absorption I for 5 seconds while not having Absorption.
name.enchantment.parry.lore.2: Cooldown: 15 seconds; each additional level enchantment increases effect level by 1.
item.pandora_heart.name: Pandora's Heart
item.pandora_heart.lore.1: Where on earth should I go to seek your figure...
item.pandora_heart.lore.2: Your singing voice comes through amid the clamor,
item.pandora_heart.lore.3: So I, fading away, am thus reborn before your eyes.
name.enchantment.pursue.lore.1: Every three times you deal melee damage,
name.enchantment.pursue.lore.2: gain (20*Level)%% melee damage aspect for 3 seconds.
name.enchantment.follow_up_on_victory.lo: After killing two enemies within 3 seconds,
you gain (40*Level)%% melee damage aspect for 5 seconds.
Next time you deal melee damage, clear the buff and begin to recalculate.
name.enchantment.regicide.lore.2: additional (3*Level) melee damage to elites & bosses.
name.enchantment.execute.lore.1: While dealing melee damage to non-Boss enemy,
name.enchantment.execute.lore.2: if the target's health drops below (7.5*Level)%% of max health,
name.enchantment.resolution.lore.1: While dealing melee damage, compared to max health,
name.enchantment.resolution.lore.2: every 10%% of max health you have above 50%% of max health,
name.enchantment.resolution.lore.3: gain (5*Level)%% melee damage aspect for 5 seconds.
name.enchantment.creativity.lore.2: gain (5*Level)%% magic damage boost for 4 seconds.
name.enchantment.scholar.lore.1: After dealing magic damage for three times in three seconds,
name.enchantment.scholar.lore.2: clear counts and deal (6*Level) magic damage to enemies in a large radius.
name.enchantment.sidestep.lore.2: Two seconds after you deal magic damage,
name.enchantment.silver_radiance.lore.1: Every time you deal magic damage in non-enchantment ways,
name.enchantment.silver_radiance.lore.2: deal (3*Level) magic damage to the nearest enemy around.
name.enchantment.research.lore.1: Gain (2*Level) mana per arcane vial you use.
name.enchantment.observation.lore.1: The first time the enemy is shot,
name.enchantment.observation.lore.2: affected with Vulnerable II for 5 seconds.
name.enchantment.observation.lore.3: Each additional level of enchantment increases the debuff level by 1.
name.enchantment.attention.lore.2: your third shot deals additional (25*Level)%% ranged damage.
name.enchantment.wander.lore.1: After killing enemies in ranged damage,
name.enchantment.wander.lore.2: gain (25*Level)%% ranged damage boost for 4 seconds.
name.enchantment.soft_pacing.lore.1: Gain ranged damage boost equals to
name.enchantment.recuperation.lore.1: While not taking damage for 12 seconds,
name.enchantment.recuperation.lore.2: you gain regeneration with effect level as (1*Level).
name.enchantment.unreal.lore.1: You gain Resistance II every 5 times you take damage,
name.enchantment.unreal.lore.2: which disappears 2 seconds after you take damage next time.
name.enchantment.unreal.lore.3: Each additional level of enchantment increases the buff by 1 level.
name.enchantment.dissipate_grief.lore.1: Upon taking damage: Gain (7*Level)s%% reduced melee/magic/projectile damage,
name.enchantment.dissipate_grief.lore.2: capped at (7*Level)s%%. Clears when you deal damage.
name.enchantment.dissipate_grief.lore.3: Upon dealing damage: Gain (10*Level)s%% bonus melee/magic/projectile damage,
name.enchantment.dissipate_grief.lore.4: capped at (30*Level)s%%. Clears when you take damage.
name.enchantment.cruelty.lore.1: Enemies that attack you are affected with Blindness for (0.25+0.25*Level) seconds.
name.enchantment.generality.lore.1: Enemies with Vulnerability deal (10*Level)%% less damage to you.
name.enchantment.stream.lore.1: Your invulnerable frame after taking damage extends by (0.25*Level) seconds.
name.enchantment.interpolation.lore.1: Upon taking damage, if you strike the attacking enemy
name.enchantment.buffer.lore.1: Affect enemies that get close to you the first time with Slowness II for 3 seconds.
name.enchantment.buffer.lore.2: Each additional level of enchantment increases the debuff level by 1.

Magic Damage & Area Control

Potions & Status Effects
Use arcane vial to cast abilities
class.scout.name: 「Scout」

Ranged Damage & mobility

class.warrior.ability1.name: 「Guardian Impact」
class.warrior.ability1.desc1:
Right Click to dash forward for a short distance. While landing, deal 8 melee damage and stun nearby enemies for 1 seconds.
Cooldown: 12s
class.warrior.ability2.name: 「Heartward」
class.warrior.ability2.desc1:
While sneaking, right‑click to gain Absorption III for 6 seconds, and mark all nearby enemies.
Killing a marked enemy extends your Absorption duration by 2 seconds and refreshes its effects.
Cooldown: 16s
class.warrior.ability2.desc2:
Absorption Level: II → III
Duration Extension per Kill: 2s → 4s
class.warrior.ability3.name: 「Crimson Pact」
class.warrior.ability3.desc1:
Press F to enter 「Pact」 stats, during which you gain +25%% melee damage boost. Per melee attack, lose 2 health; per enemy killed, no blood lost for this attack, restore 1 health instead; your ability cooldown is reduced by 1.5s. The stats last for 8 seconds.
Cooldown: 12s
class.warrior.ability3.desc2:
Melee Damage Boost：25%% -> 40%%
Restoration per Kill：1 Health -> 2 Health
Cooldown Reduction: 1.5s -> 3s
class.warrior.ability4.name: 「Gilded Domain」
class.warrior.ability4.desc1:
Drop your weapon to summon a protection domain lasting for 12s, with 5 durability, where you gain Resistance II.
All enemies getting close will be knocked back, and all projectiles from the enemies will be destroyed. The action costs the domain 1 durability.
Cooldown: 15s
class.warrior.ability4.desc2:
Resistance Level: 2 -> 4
Durability: 5 -> 7
Enemies knocked back take additional 5 melee damage and are affected with Blindness for 0.5s.
class.warrior.ability5.name: 「Shockwave」
class.warrior.ability5.desc1:
Sneak + left click to cast shockwave forward, affecting enemies with Weakness I and Vulnerability II for 8 seconds, and dealing 8 melee damage.
Cooldown: 12s
class.warrior.ability6.name: 「Perseverance」
class.warrior.ability6.desc1: Gain +1 and +10%% max health boost. Deal 3 melee damage to the attacker while taking damage.
class.warrior.ability6.desc2: Gain +2 and +20%% max health boost. Deal 4 melee damage to the attacker while taking damage.
class.warrior.ability7.name: 「Rage Blood」
class.warrior.ability7.desc1:
Per 2 melee attack, you gain 1 stack 「Rage」. Gain 3%% speed boost per stack, capped at 8 stacks.
Lose 1 stack 「Rage」 every 5 seconds without melee attack.
Press F while sneaking to cost all 「Rage」. Per stack of 「Rage」 you cost, gain 5%% melee damage and 3%% attack speed boost, lasting for 8 seconds.
class.warrior.ability7.desc2:
Max Rage Stack: 8 -> 12
You gain 1 stack 「Rage」 per 1 melee attack now.
class.warrior.ability8.name: 「Annihilation」
class.warrior.ability8.desc1:
Wielding axe, your melee attack deals additional 20%% damage (abilities are not affected), and killing enemies deal 15%% damage of your dealt damage to enemies nearby.
Wielding sword, you gain 15%% defence boost, and killing enemies grants you +15%% attack speed for 5 seconds.
class.warrior.ability8.desc2:
Axe AoE Damage: 15%% -> 25%%
Sword Killing Buff: +15%% -> +25%%
class.mage.ability1.name: 「Magic Ray」
class.mage.ability1.desc1:
Left click to cast a magic ray, piercing enemies and dealing 7 magic damage.
Cooldown: 4s
class.mage.ability1.desc2:
Now you get two charges of magic ray when off cooldown.
Cooldown: 4s -> 3s
class.mage.ability2.name: 「Arcane Bullet」
class.mage.ability2.desc1:
Right click to shoot an arcane bullet that deals 5 magic damage, igniting and marking the target. When the marked enemy takes magic damage, clear the mark and deal 7 magic damage to the enemy nearby.
Cooldown: 12s
class.mage.ability2.desc2:
AoE Damage: 7 -> 16
Increases the radius of the AoE damage.
class.mage.ability3.name: 「Snowstorm」
class.mage.ability3.desc1:
Right click while sneaking to summon a snowstorm, moving forward, dealing 7 magic damage and affecting with Slowness II for 6 seconds to enemies.
Cooldown: 14s
class.mage.ability3.desc2:
Magic Damage: 7 -> 14
Slowness Level: II -> III
Slowness Duration: 6s -> 10s
class.mage.ability4.name: 「Sakura Step」
class.mage.ability4.desc1:
Drop your wand to teleport 8 blocks forward, dealing 6 magic damage to enemies on the path. Per enemy attacked, you gain +5%% speed for 8 seconds, capped at +25%% speed.
Cooldown: 12 seconds
class.mage.ability4.desc2:
Magic Damage: 6 -> 8
Teleport Distance: 8 -> 12
Additionally, reduces your cooldown duration by 1 seconds per enemy attacked, capped at -4 seconds.
class.mage.ability5.name: 「Chaos Nova」
class.mage.ability5.desc1:
Left click while sneaking to summon a Chaos Nova. While it hits enemies or blocks, create a black hole, which keeps pulling enemies nearby to the center, dealing 3 magic damage and applying 2 seconds of Vulnerability II per sec. The black hole lasts for 5 seconds.
Cooldown: 12 seconds
class.mage.ability5.desc2:
The black hole lasts for 8 seconds with larger radius now.
Vulnerability Level: II -> IV
class.mage.ability6.name: 「Mirror Shatter」
class.mage.ability6.desc1:
Press F to unleash 2 attacks to enemies forward within 1 second, with each dealing 5 magic damage. For each attack, if you successfully damage the enemy, reduce all your other abilities' cooldown by 1 second.
Cooldown: 13 seconds
class.mage.ability6.desc2:
Attack Counts: 2 -> 3
Additionally, the ability reduces the cooldown of itself now.
class.mage.ability7.name: 「Fairy Tale」
class.mage.ability7.desc1:
While using abilities, you gain 1 stack corresponding 「story」. All stacks of 「story」 disappear while you have not used abilities for 8 seconds. When you have more than 3 stacks of 「story」, cost the first stack, and trigger following effects:
Magic Ray: deal 8 magic damage to random 1[2] enemies nearby
Arcane Bullet: when marked enemy died, deal 6[16] magic damage to all enemies nearby
Snowstorm: freeze all enemies nearby for 0.5[1] second
Sakura Step: Drop your wand while sneaking to teleport backward and trigger same effects, with individual cooldown
Chaos Nova: apply extra Weakness I[II]
Mirror Shatter: each attack deals additional 1[2] magic damage
class.mage.ability7.desc2: While using abilities at level II, trigger effects in "[]"
class.mage.ability8.name: 「Angel Voice」
class.mage.ability8.desc1: While the enemy is attacked from the mage with 2 different abilities, deal 4 magic damage to enemies nearby.
class.mage.ability8.desc2: Additionally, while the enemy is attacked from the mage with 3 different abilities, deal 4 magic damage to enemies in a large range.
class.alchemist.ability1.name: 「Eternal River of Poison」
class.alchemist.ability1.desc1:
Your arcane vial has +1 basic magic damage, +2 Vulnerability Level.
If it doesn't apply Vulnerability before, apply Vulnerability II for 8 seconds instead.
class.alchemist.ability1.desc2:
Your arcane vial has +2 basic magic damage, +3 Vulnerability Level and -20%% mana cost.
If it doesn't apply Vulnerability before, apply Vulnerability III for 8 seconds instead.
class.alchemist.ability2.name: 「Moonlight Raindew」
class.alchemist.ability2.desc1:
Left Click to consume twice mana cost to hurl three arcane  vial forward in a scatter pattern. Enemies attacked are marked for 4 seconds. When a marked enemy takes magic damage, nearby enemies take magic damage equal to 80%% of your arcane vial damage, and then clear their marks.
Cooldown: 5s
class.alchemist.ability2.desc2:
Damage Multiplier: 80%% → 120%%
Additionally, marks are no longer cleared by magic damage.
class.alchemist.ability3.name: 「Palace Elixir」
class.alchemist.ability3.desc1:
Press F to cost mana of your arcane vial to gain +10%% magic damage boost and +15%% speed boost, lasting for 8 seconds. If your arcane vial has X basic magic damage, gain (3*X)%% magic damage boost additionally.
Cooldown: 5s
class.alchemist.ability3.desc2:
Addition Magic Boost: 3*X -> 5*X
Buff Duration: 6秒 -> 8秒
class.alchemist.ability4.name: 「Angelic Garden」
class.alchemist.ability4.desc1:
Press F while sneaking, in the next 20 seconds, you gain Absorption I for 5 seconds every 5 seconds.
Cooldown: 30s
class.alchemist.ability4.desc2: Now you gain Absorption I for 3 seconds every 3 seconds. Additionally, when you use the ability, you gain Absorption II for 20 seconds.
class.alchemist.ability5.name: 「Charged Release」
class.alchemist.ability5.desc1:
Drop your arcane vial and hurl a gravity‑ignoring, high‑velocity bomb forward. It deals 150%% Magic Damage of your held Arcane Vial with 125%% range.
Gain 1 charge of this ability for every 3 enemies slain, capped at 2 charges.
class.alchemist.ability6.name: 「Umbral Pool」
class.alchemist.ability6.desc1:
While sneaking, your arcane vial creates a poison pool, dealing magic damage that equals to 15%% of your arcane vial's basic damage and applying Slowness I and Weakness I. The pool lasts for 6 seconds.
Cooldown: 10s
class.alchemist.ability7.name: 「Analyze」
class.alchemist.ability7.desc1:
When an enemy is killed, drop a 「Lucky Gift」, which grants the picker 1 stack of 「Gift」, capped at 3 stacks. Per stack of 「Gift」 the player owns, gain +5%% mana regeneration speed and +5%% defence. If the player is not at max health, consume 1 stack of 「Gift」 to recover 1 health, till recovering to max health.
Cooldown: 5s
class.alchemist.ability7.desc2:
Mana Regeneration Speed Boost: +5%% -> +7%%
Defence Boost: +5%% -> +7%%
Max 「Gift」 Stacks: 3 -> 5
class.alchemist.ability8.name: 「Arcane Wellspring」
class.alchemist.ability8.desc1: Nearby enemies hit by your arcane vial take +1 magic damage per debuff on them. Furthermore, your arcane vial clears Vulnerability and Weakness of allies.
class.alchemist.ability8.desc2:
Magic Damage per debuff: 1 -> 2
Additionally, enemies take extra 2 magic damage for each debuff of level 2 or higher they possess.
class.scout.ability1.name: 「Crafty Hands」
class.scout.ability1.desc1:
Left click to fire an arrow.
Cooldown: 4s
class.scout.ability1.desc2:
Upon cooldown completion, gain 2 charges of this skill.
Cooldown: 4s -> 3s
class.scout.ability2.name: 「Eagle's Glare」
class.scout.ability2.desc1:
Firing while sneaking, your arrows are converted into explosive arrows. On hitting an enemy, they deal area ranged damage equal to 125%% of your weapon's damage, knock up the enemies and apply Slow Falling I for 5 seconds.
Cooldown: 12 seconds
class.scout.ability2.desc2:
Damage Multiplier: 125%% -> 175%%
Your explosive arrows plant a mine upon hitting a target or landing. Enemies passing over it take ranged damage equal to 80%% of your weapon's damage.
class.scout.ability3.name: 「Sylphstride」
class.scout.ability3.desc1:
You gain +15%% speed boost. Drop your bow/crossbow to leap forward, and stun nearest enemy for 0.75 seconds.
Cooldown: 5s
class.scout.ability3.desc2:
Now stun all nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds.
Cooldown: 5s -> 3s
class.scout.ability4.name: 「Verge of Sight」
class.scout.ability4.desc1:
Click F to mark all enemies in a large range and apply with Vulnerability II for 10 seconds. When marked enemies take ranged damage for the first time, they additionally take ranged damage that equals to 70%% of your bow/crossbow damage.
Cooldown: 15s
class.scout.ability4.desc2:
Damage Multiplier: 70%% -> 100%%
Additionally, killing marked enemies reduces the cooldown of this ability by 1 second.
class.scout.ability5.name: 「Scapegoat」
class.scout.ability5.desc1:
Left click while sneaking, throw a dummy that attracts nearby enemies, and can take damage for 5 times. When killed, the dummy blinded nearby enemies for 3 seconds.
Cooldown: 10s
(Begin to enter cooldown after the dummy is killed)
class.scout.ability5.desc2:
Max Take-Damage Times: 5 -> 8
When killed, enemies around the dummy take ranged damage that equals to your bow/crossbow's damage. By left click while sneaking, you can kill the dummy.
class.scout.ability6.name: 「Chain Shot」
class.scout.ability6.desc1: When your shot hits an enemy, deal ranged damage equal to 60%% of your bow/crossbow damage to the 1 closest nearby enemies.
class.scout.ability7.name: 「Core of Cloudsea」
class.scout.ability7.desc1:
Press F while sneaking to launch a wind bomb, which explodes after hitting an enemy or block, deals 12 ranged damage to nearby enemies, and creates a cloud lasting for 5 seconds. The cloud continues pulling nearby enemies to the center, and applying Slowness II.
Cooldown: 12s
class.scout.ability7.desc2:
Additionally applies Weakness II.
Ranged Damage: 12 -> 18
Cloud Duration: 5s -> 7s
class.scout.ability8.name: 「Featherlight」
class.scout.ability8.desc1:
You gain permanent Haste I, and will not be slowed while using bow/crossbow.
You gain additional 15%% ranged damage boost while airborne.
class.scout.ability8.desc2:
You gain permanent Haste II, and additional Slow Falling while using bow/crossbow.
You gain additional 25%% ranged damage boost while airborne.
class.assassin.ability1.name: 「Shadow Step」
class.assassin.ability1.desc1:
Right click to dash forward (until hitting a block or enemy), and gain +60%% melee damage boost for 2.5 seconds. Each enemy you kill during this reduces this ability's cooldown by 1 second.
Cooldown: 10s
class.assassin.ability1.desc2:
Damage Boost: 60%% -> 100%%
Cooldown Reduction Per Kill: 1 -> 2
class.assassin.ability2.name: 「Sword Dance」
class.assassin.ability2.desc1:
Press F while sneaking to deal melee damage to nearby enemies, which equals to (4+0.5*X) if your weapon has X damage, and freeze the enemies for 1.5 seconds.
Cooldown: 12s
class.assassin.ability3.name: 「Curse of Smoke」
class.assassin.ability3.desc1:
Release smoke that lasts for 8 seconds, applying Slowness II and Weakness I to enemies within a large radius.
Cooldown: 14s
class.assassin.ability3.desc2:
Slowness Level: II -> III
Weakness Level: I -> II
Now additionally summon a smoke cloud that follows you, lasting 6 seconds and applying the same effects.
class.assassin.ability4.name: 「Dagger of Reverie」
class.assassin.ability4.desc1:
Left click while sneaking to throw piercing daggers forward in 3 directions, marking enemies and dealing 4 melee damage. When marked enemies take attack in the next 4 seconds, they additionally take melee damage that equals  to 30%% of your weapon's damage.
Cooldown: 10s
class.assassin.ability4.desc2:
Melee Damage: 4 -> 6
Melee Damage Multiplier: 30%% -> 60%%
Cooldown: 10s -> 8s
class.assassin.ability5.name: 「Chains of Heaven」
class.assassin.ability5.desc1:
Drop your weapon to throw a flying blade, marking hit enemies for 10 seconds. Killing a marked enemy reduces all  abilities' cooldown by 1 seconds, and grants +20%% attack speed and +30%% melee damage for 6 seconds.
Cooldown: 8s
class.assassin.ability5.desc2:
Killing an enemy additionally reduces this ability's cooldown by 2 seconds.
Melee Damage Bonus: +30%% -> +60%%
Attack Speed Bonus: +20%% -> +40%%
class.assassin.ability6.name: 「Judgement」
class.assassin.ability6.desc1: Your critical strikes deal an additional 15%% melee damage against normal enemies, and an additional 35%% melee damage against elites and bosses.
class.assassin.ability6.desc2: Your critical strikes deal an additional 25%% melee damage against normal enemies, 60%% against elites, and 80%% against bosses.
class.assassin.ability7.name: 「Moon Radiance」
class.assassin.ability7.desc1: Per ability you use, gain 1 stack of 「Moonlight」, capped at 2 stacks. In melee attack, cost 1 stack of 「Moonlight」 to deal 6 melee damage to enemies straight forward and nearby.
class.assassin.ability8.name: 「Fantasy Cloak」
class.assassin.ability8.desc1: For X ability points you possess, every time you deal (30+10*X) melee damage, nearby enemies are blinded for 0.75 seconds. When you strike an enemy in melee from behind, you deal an additional 35%% melee damage.
